title: Coinsurance Shares Payable on Each Dental Benefit Category
content:
Share of the allowed amount that each of the Optional Supplemental Benefit Riders pays, by dental benefit category, stated as a percentage.

| Benefit category | Preventive Dental | Vision Plus | Hearing Advantage | Comprehensive Dental | Premier Dental | Dental Vision Hearing Bundle |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Preventive dental care | 100 | 0 | 0 | 100 | 100 | 100 |
| Basic restorative dental care | 0 | 0 | 0 | 80 | 80 | 80 |
| Major restorative dental care | 0 | 0 | 0 | 50 | 60 | 60 |
| Root canal treatment | 0 | 0 | 0 | 50 | 60 | 60 |
| Gum treatment | 0 | 0 | 0 | 50 | 60 | 60 |
| Oral surgery | 0 | 0 | 0 | 50 | 60 | 60 |
| Dentures | 0 | 0 | 0 | 50 | 50 | 50 |
| Implants | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 50 | 50 |

Every figure in the table is a percentage of the allowed amount. The columns are the Ridgecrest Preventive Dental Rider, the Ridgecrest Vision Plus Rider, the Ridgecrest Hearing Advantage Rider, the Ridgecrest Comprehensive Dental Rider, the Ridgecrest Premier Dental Rider and the Ridgecrest Dental Vision Hearing Bundle Rider in turn.

## Orthodontic treatment

| Rider | Orthodontic treatment covered |
|---|---|
| Ridgecrest Preventive Dental Rider | no |
| Ridgecrest Vision Plus Rider | no |
| Ridgecrest Hearing Advantage Rider | no |
| Ridgecrest Comprehensive Dental Rider | no |
| Ridgecrest Premier Dental Rider | no |
| Ridgecrest Dental Vision Hearing Bundle Rider | no |

No rider in this schedule covers orthodontic treatment at all.

## Points of judgement on the schedule

**A share of 0 stands for a category the rider carries no coinsurance percentage for.** The Ridgecrest Vision Plus Rider and the Ridgecrest Hearing Advantage Rider carry 0 on every dental category in the table; the Ridgecrest Preventive Dental Rider carries 100 on preventive dental care alone and 0 on the rest; the Ridgecrest Comprehensive Dental Rider carries 0 on implants.

**Where two riders differ, it is by category and not across the board.** The Ridgecrest Comprehensive Dental Rider and the Ridgecrest Premier Dental Rider carry the same 100 on preventive dental care, the same 80 on basic restorative dental care and the same 50 on dentures, and differ at 50 against 60 on major restorative dental care, root canal treatment, gum treatment and oral surgery, and at 0 against 50 on implants.
